summary: Kerb of a campus turning circle, with shuttle, taxi and No Stopping signs.
reasons: Taxi zone, loading and No Stopping signs
Tight circular loop, no room to stop

drivers.seclusion: Campus buildings and tree canopy only, no dwellings mapped, but a busy pick-up point for pedestrians.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow circular road with islands and canopy; the kerb sits inside the vehicle path, so a van would block the loop.
drivers.traffic: University shuttle, taxis and drop-offs run round the loop all day.
drivers.convention: No Stopping at all times for the shuttle pocket, taxi zone and 2-minute loading; nobody parks here.

flags: No Stopping at all times (shuttle only), Taxi Zone, 2-minute Loading Zone
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over most of the loop, shaded from the west and north.

best_section.where: outer kerb of the circular slip-road loop off Chancellors Place
